testcase.name: a terminal mission settles rather than being asked about forever()
a command the Gateway is running is not sent a second time()
a command with no command id is asked about by message id and still resends()
a command the Gateway did not answer for at all is sent again()
a command the Gateway has never heard of is sent again()
the identity asked about is the identity the answer is matched by()
a mixed answer splits rather than settling or resending everything()
a command the Gateway admitted without opening a mission is settled()
a durable admission with no recorded result remains recoverable()
order is preserved, because the owner issued these in an order()
